prompt_json.q: Eleven sectors, eleven funds
steps: GICS sorts each company into one of 11 sectors by its main business.
Each sector has a Select Sector SPDR fund. XLK is tech, XLF financials, XLE energy.
Together, the 11 sector indexes cover every company in the S&P 500.

lesson_text: Over the two days the index lost 1%. The 2x fund lost 4%. Chop works against these funds.

prompt_json.q: What a 2x or 3x fund does
steps: A 2x or 3x fund aims for two or three times the index's move for one day. Then it resets.
Take $100 in a 2x fund. The index drops 10%, so the fund drops 20%, to $80.
Next day the index rises 10%. The fund gains 20%, but only on $80, so it reaches $96.
Over the two days the index lost 1%. The 2x fund lost 4%. Chop works against these funds.

sources.quote: Leveraged ETFs seek to deliver multiples of the daily performance of the index or benchmark they track.

sources.name: ProShares: TQQQ: UltraPro QQQ
sources.quote: TQQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times (3x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index®.

sources.name: SEC, Investor.gov: Updated Investor Bulletin: Leveraged and Inverse ETFs (Aug. 29, 2023)
sources.quote: Most leveraged and inverse ETFs “reset” daily, meaning that they are designed to achieve their stated objectives on a daily basis.

sources.name: FINRA: The Lowdown on Leveraged and Inverse Exchange-Traded Products (Investor Insights)
sources.quote: At the close of trading on Tuesday, the index is down 10 percent to 90, resulting in a 20 percent loss for the ETP, bringing its value down to $80.

sources.name: FINRA: The Lowdown on Leveraged and Inverse Exchange-Traded Products (Investor Insights)
sources.quote: Then, on Wednesday, the index closes up 10 percent at 99, resulting in a gain of 20 percent for the ETP. However, 20 percent of $80 is just $16, meaning the ETP’s value is now at $96.

sources.name: FINRA: The Lowdown on Leveraged and Inverse Exchange-Traded Products (Investor Insights)
sources.quote: But over the course of these days the index lost just 1 percent, while the 2x leveraged ETP lost 4 percent.

sources.name: ProShares: TQQQ: UltraPro QQQ
sources.quote: Smaller index gains/losses and higher index volatility contribute to returns worse than the Daily Target. Larger index gains/losses and lower index volatility contribute to returns better than the Daily Target.
